blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro – A bomb threat rocked the Calapan City Hall Complex on Wednesday at 1:20 p.m., prompting a complete shutdown of a nearby campus. The threat was posted on the Facebook community page Calapan Barter/Buy and Sell Community by an anonymous participant who said, “May bomba ako nilagay ko sa may city hall di ninyo makikita may gusto binayaran lang ako para patayin ang mayor ninyo na si Doy Leachon.” (I have just installed a bomb at City Hall. You won’t find it. I was paid to kill your mayor, Doy Leachon). This prompted City officials to order […]... Keep on reading: Calapan City bomb threat declared a hoax
